notes:
- The update check now sends the app's version, the Mac's chip type and a
  random id that the app replaces on the first check of every month, so
  sitrep.md can count how many copies are running. The site keeps a hash of
  the id for that month and nothing else; no IP address or document detail is
  stored, and one month's id cannot be matched to the next. sitrep.md/security
  lists exactly what is sent.

- Mobile sync pushes from one server per Mac. The release app is the only
  build that pushes; a source checkout or the dev app says so in Settings and
  keeps its toggle disabled, unless started with `SITREP_SYNC=1`. A start also
  stops the pusher a previous server left behind, read from `watch.pid`. On
  2026-09-10 five pushers leaked by the dev server's reloads and the installed
  app's one rewrote each other's documents 1,403 times and hit Cloudflare's
  daily D1 write cap; the pusher now backs off after a failed push (5s
  doubling to 5 minutes) instead of retrying every 3s.

- Find highlights leave when you do. In the Mac app, deleting the find text or
  closing the bar left every match painted, and a search's terms stayed under
  the next find, because WebKit repaints a highlight only when the registered
  object itself changes. The bar now empties its highlights in place, and
  `verify:webkit` reads Safari's pixels to hold it.
